verdict.rationale: Cursor CLI has a documented print/headless mode explicitly for non-interactive scripts, CI pipelines, and automation, with structured JSON/stream-json output, non-zero exit codes on failure, API key auth for scripts, and a documented GitHub Actions recipe. This is corroborated by a live-checked docs index and OpenAPI/CLI reference pages. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on validation of headless CLI scripting in a real CI pipeline.
